barrow.name: the Barrow of #barrow_king#
barrow.start_label: The Barrow of Kings - a grave-digger at the mouth of an old barrow

mound.name: Barrow Mound
mound.description: A long grassy mound rises from the earth like the back of a sleeping beast. At its near end, the great stones that sealed the entrance have been heaved aside, leaving a black mouth that breathes cold air.

exits.description: A dark opening leads into the mound.

description.text: Your light shows a low passage of fitted stone slabs. Every surface is carved with interlocking beasts that seem to writhe as the shadows move.
The passage is so dark you feel your way along cold, carved stone. Grey daylight leaks in from the entrance behind you.

antechamber.name: Antechamber
antechamber.description: A round chamber with a domed roof. Passages lead off to either side, and to the north a doorway of green bronze stands open on the dark.

ossuary.name: Ossuary
ossuary.description: Niches line the walls from floor to ceiling, and every niche holds a skull. Hundreds of empty eyes watch you come in.
ossuary.brief: The ossuary, full of watching skulls.

flooded_hall.name: Flooded Hall
flooded_hall.description: Black water has seeped in to fill this long hall to the knee. Stone coffins rise from it like islands.

sanctum.name: Sanctum of the King
sanctum.description: The heart of the barrow. A faint radiance hangs in the air with no source you can find. Gold glints in every corner, dulled by dust.

barrow_runes: The runes read: "Here sleeps #barrow_king#, ring-giver, shield of his people. Let no hand wake him."
Most of the carving is beasts devouring beasts. Along the bottom runs a line of runes: "The light was given to the dark to keep."
You trace the runes with a finger: "Whoso takes the light takes the burden."

sealing_stones.name: sealing stones
sealing_stones.description: Each stone must weigh as much as a cart. Something shifted them from the inside: the scrape marks all point outward.

push: You might as well push a hill.

fresh_tracks.name: tracks
fresh_tracks.appearance: Footprints in the mud lead into the barrow. None lead out.
fresh_tracks.description: Several people, heavy boots, a few days old. They went in. They did not come back.

barrow_carvings.name: carvings
barrow_carvings.description: Interlocking beasts devour one another in an endless chain. Here and there are lines of runes.

torch_sconce.name: iron sconce
torch_sconce.appearance: An iron sconce is fixed to the wall.
torch_sconce.description: A rusted iron bracket for holding a torch.

description.text: The torch burns with a smoky orange flame.
A stick wrapped in pitch-soaked rags. You'd need a spark to light it, but someone left a flint wedged in the sconce, so lighting it should be easy enough.

offering_bowl.name: offering bowl
offering_bowl.appearance: A shallow stone offering bowl sits on a plinth.
offering_bowl.description: Worn smooth inside by centuries of offerings.

features.name: dried flower
features.description: A small posy, so old it crumbles at a touch.

do: You lay {target} in the bowl. For a moment the barrow seems to hold its breath, then let it out more easily.

bone_pile.name: pile of bones
bone_pile.appearance: A heap of loose bones has collapsed from the lower niches.
bone_pile.description: Arm bones, leg bones, ribs, all jumbled together. Something glints underneath.

take: You'd rather leave the dead their bones.

bone_key.name: key of carved bone
bone_key.description: A long key carved from a single bone, its bow shaped like a little crowned skull.

skull_niches.name: skulls
skull_niches.description: Hundreds of skulls. Some have coins in their eye sockets. You leave them be.

take: The skulls are watching. You leave them be.

barrow_wight.name: barrow wight
barrow_wight.appearance: A barrow wight stands knee-deep in the water, its armour green with age and its eyes cold blue fire.
barrow_wight.description: Bone and verdigris and the memory of a man. It guards the coffins of its brothers.

props.death_text: The wight lets out a long, cold sigh and crumbles into the water.

profile.motive_text: guard my king's rest until the stars burn out
goals: see the king's light returned to him
profile.backstory: It speaks in a voice like wind through a crack in a tomb. "I was the king's shield-bearer. I am still."
greet: The wight's blue eyes flare. "Who disturbs the king's rest?"
profile.epilogue: In the barrow, a shield-bearer lays down his shield, and sleeps.

warrior_coffin.name: stone coffin
warrior_coffin.appearance: The largest coffin bears the carving of a warrior with a sword on his breast.
warrior_coffin.description: The lid is carved with a sleeping warrior.

features.name: barrow blade
features.description: A long iron sword, pattern-welded, its edge still keen after a thousand years.

do: The wight hisses and moves between you and the coffin.
You heave the lid aside. Inside: {self.contents}.

dark_water.name: black water
dark_water.description: Still and black and very cold. Things gleam on the bottom.

features.name: drowned shield
features.description: A round lime-wood shield with an iron boss, waterlogged but sound.

barrow_sarcophagus.name: sarcophagus

appearance.text: In the centre of the chamber stands a great stone sarcophagus, its lid carved with the likeness of a crowned king.

barrow_sarcophagus.description: Granite, carved with ravens and ring-ships. The lid is heavy, but not immovable.

kings_effigy.name: effigy
kings_effigy.description: The carved king's hands are folded around... nothing. Whatever he once held has been placed inside the sarcophagus instead.

barrow_relic.name: #relic_name#
barrow_relic.description: {self.Name} gives off a soft, steady light that never flickers. It is warm to the touch, like something alive.

feature.name: bronze door

appearance.text: A great door of green bronze stands open.
A great door of green bronze bars the way, its keyhole set in the mouth of a grinning skull.

feature.description: Green with age and worked with scenes of a king giving rings to his warriors.

bronze_door.open_text: {key.The} turns in the skull's mouth with a dry click, and the bronze door swings inward on groaning hinges.
bronze_door.locked_text: The bronze door won't budge. The skull-shaped lock grins at you.
bronze_door.blocked: A bronze door, shut fast, bars the way.

feature.name: rune-sealed coffer

appearance.text: A stone coffer stands open, its runes dark.
A stone coffer sits here, sealed by runes that glow a faint, cold blue.

feature.description: The runes say: only the light may open what the dark has sealed.

rune_sealed_coffer.open_text: You hold {key} to the runes. One by one they flicker and die, and the coffer's lid slides aside.
rune_sealed_coffer.locked_text: The runes flare cold blue when you touch the lid. It will not open for you.

title: The Stolen Light
Grave Goods
The King's Lamp
barrow_desecration.hook: Somebody has broken open {tomb} and stolen {relic} from its resting place. Since that night the dead have not slept easily, and neither has anyone else.
barrow_desecration.goal: Recover {relic} and return it to {resting_place} in {tomb}.

resolutions.title: Return the light
resolutions.text: You lay {means} back in {target}. A long sigh runs through the stones, and everything that was restless grows still.

lore.title: The theft
lore.text: On a moonless night someone carried {relic} out of {tomb}. They say the skulls in the ossuary turned to watch them go.

lore.title: Who would do such a thing?
lore.text: Folk whisper that {villain} has been seen with more coin than usual. They say {villain} would do anything to {villain.motive}.

barrow_desecration.ending: With {relic} returned, the barrow is quiet again. Lights in the village burn a little brighter, and nobody can quite say why.

title: The Shield-Bearer
What the Dead Keep
barrow_restless_guardian.hook: Something has woken in {tomb}: {villain}, an old guardian who now walks the land at night, hunting for a light that was taken from its king long ago.
barrow_restless_guardian.goal: Find {relic} and use it to lay {villain} to rest.

resolutions.title: Lay the guardian to rest
resolutions.text: {target.The} takes {means} in hands of bone. For a moment you see a man, young and tired, and then only dust, and a light settling into the dark.
{target.The} falls, and its long watch ends with it.

lore.title: The shield-bearer
lore.text: When the king was laid in {tomb}, his shield-bearer asked to be buried at the door, so that he could keep guarding him forever.

barrow_restless_guardian.ending: The guardian sleeps. The barrow keeps its king, and the night belongs to the living again.

barrow_king.title: The barrow king
barrow_king.text: #barrow_king# was a ring-giver and a shield to his people. When he died they built {area.barrow} over him and sealed it with stones no living man could move.

barrow_runes.title: Runes in the barrow
barrow_runes.text: The runes on the barrow walls read: 'The light was given to the dark to keep. Whoso takes the light takes the burden.'

barrow_tracks.title: Footprints
barrow_tracks.text: Grave-robbers went into the barrow last autumn. Their footprints lead in. None lead out.
